items.description: South Devon coast from Start Point to Dawlish Warren
items.eaAreaName: Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
items.message:
High tides tomorrow morning may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 06:30AM  on Tuesday 10th November 
Local Areas particularly at risk include Torbay, Teignmouth, Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish.
  
The high tide at Teignmouth on Tuesday is at 06:45AM,  times of high water will vary along the coast.  Forecast total high tide level is 2.24mAOD, which is 0.16 metres above tide table level.  Force 6 easterly  winds and offshore wave heights of over 1.8m are forecast over the high tide.

Most affected areas will be coastal roads and footpaths. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 12:30PM on Tuesday 10 November or as the situation changes.
